type: Open Source Â· AI Voice Typing
bullets: Solo-built Bulbul, a free and open-source AI voice typing app for Windows, macOS, Linux, and Android: hold a hotkey, speak, release, and clean text appears at the cursor.
Combined Whisper speech-to-text with an LLM cleanup layer and a BYOK design so users bring their own API keys.
Kept dictation ephemeral with no Bulbul-owned backend, so users' voice data is never stored.
Crossed 500+ downloads on GitHub releases, with users opening issues and requesting features, competing directly with established commercial voice-AI products.
